prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approachable, take it and complete task, else if visible, approach safely or move randomly. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToRandomLocation    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = TaskSpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectSafeToTake    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO TaskSpecificTask
	END
